deities.name: Hathruna
deities.rationale: Fungi, roots, spores, decomposition, and ecological rebirth make Hathruna the central Jaspey deity.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Nefarokir
deities.rationale: Treating decomposition as an archive of identity and memory connects Jaspey funerary ecology to Nefarokir.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Thoryn-Rahek
deities.rationale: Toxin filtering, unusual symbiosis, and adaptive spore forms create a wary ritual association with aberrant life and mutation.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
